name: Files
description: Read, list, find and search files -- only inside the folders named below. Built into GENGHIS (D55).
_comment_enabled: OFF as shipped. Switching it on lets a model read everything under `roots` (never key or credential files).
_comment_roots: Name -> folder. The model works in 'name/sub/path' and cannot leave these folders: paths are resolved to their real location first, so a symlink or '..' does not escape. List only what a model should see. On Windows: "E:\Projects".
_comment_write: true adds write_file and replace_text. Every write keeps the previous version under <root>/.genghis-backup/<time>/ and the chat shows the diff. There is no delete, and .git is never written.
_comment_node: Add "node": "<fleet id>" when the folders live on another box than the one answering the chat; that box's serve does the reading, and ITS copy of this file decides what is allowed.
